en: This is a vintage-style postcard featuring an illustrated farm scene with white buildings with red roofs, a courtyard with two pigs, and a person in rural attire. The text below the image is in Dutch and references an old farm at the Ter Doest Abbey near Lissewege, Belgium. The card includes a promotional tagline for 'Liebig' products, with a handwritten signature and other printed information.
